description: Composer drafts don't keep secrets that weren't typed. The screen is the default 393x727 phone. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} exists. Call "stored" returns the IDs of the secrets the server has stored for it, as a JSON array. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does (visible elements only); "named X" means an exact name match. "The composer" is [data-testid="message-input"], "the row" [data-testid="secret-bar"] and "its button" [data-testid="secret-bar-action"]. "The drafts" means the result of eval Object.keys(localStorage).filter((k) => k.startsWith("shelley-draft:")).map((k) => localStorage.getItem(k)).join(" "). "Paste X" means eval (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="message-input"]'); el.focus(); el.value += X; el.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent("input", { bubbles: true, inputType: "insertFromPaste" })); })(). "Delete X" means the same with el.value = el.value.replace(X, "") and inputType "deleteContentBackward". Call "checks" returns how many of the composer's secret checks the server has answered since call "reset checks". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new. Fill the composer with "first draft typed". The URL should come to contain "/c/" (allow 10s), as the draft is saved; then the composer should have the value exactly "first draft typed", and the drafts should contain "first draft typed" (allow 10s). Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Fill the composer with "note: ". The drafts should contain "note: " (allow 10s). 3. Paste "postgres://app:Tz8qWm3RkP5vX7@db.internal:5432/app". The row should contain the text "Captured on send" (allow 10s). The drafts must not contain "Tz8qWm3RkP5vX7". 4. Call "reset checks". Delete "7". Call "checks" until it returns "1". The drafts must not contain "Tz8qWm3RkP5vX". 5. Call "reset checks". Delete "postgres://app:Tz8qWm3RkP5vX@db.internal:5432/app": the composer should have the value exactly "note: ". Call "checks" until it returns "1". Fill the composer with "note: done". The drafts should contain "note: done" (allow 10s), and must not contain "Tz8qWm3RkP5vX". 6. Fill the composer with "delay: 60", click [data-testid="send-button"], and [data-testid="agent-thinking"] should be visible (allow 30s). The composer should come to have the value exactly "" (allow 10s), as the send is accepted. 7. Paste "token postgres://app:Hd4sYt8MzJ3cW6@db.internal/app". The row should contain "Captured on send" (allow 10s). Call "fail queue". Call "reset checks". 8. Click [data-testid="send-options-button"], then [data-testid="queue-option"] once visible. Call "queue failed" until it returns "true". 9. The composer should have the value exactly "token postgres://app:Hd4sYt8MzJ3cW6@db.internal/app" (allow 10s), and call "checks" should return "1" (allow 10s). The drafts must not contain "Hd4sYt8MzJ3cW6".
